Hi Sarah,

I’m following up again as I still have not received the shipping label. It
has been several days since my last email, and I am keen to get this return
processed.

Could you please update me on the status of this request and let me know
when I can expect the label to arrive?

Kind regards,
Michael H.
Note to the team: I'll pull the current state of the order and the RMA before replying.
Handed to the team · return label cost 392.10 CAD is above my purchase cap ····warehouse copy doe

Hi Michael,

You're still right to be chasing, and I'm sorry you've had to.

Here is exactly where it sits. Your claim is approved and the return is logged as Shop····, (address hidden) back to our Rotterdam warehouse. The one route that works for a UK unit of this value is a FedEx duties paid service, which quotes at about 392 Canadian dollars, and that is far above what I'm allowed to buy from my side. That is the whole reason it has stalled, and it is a buying decision rather than a paperwork one.

I have put it in front of the team with the quote, the route and the reference attached, so there is nothing left for anyone to work out. They open at 10am Eastern today and it is the first thing on their list. The label comes straight to this address, and the answer reaches you by email so you don't need to sit watching for it.

When it lands, write Shop···· clearly on the outside of the box. The new Nexus S1 with the UK plug goes out to you at no cost as soon as your unit reaches Rotterdam, and I'll tell you when it moves.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Thank you for that. It's greatly appreciated. Thank you again for all your
help.

Kind regards

Michael H.

Hi Michael,

You're very welcome, and thank you for being so patient while we sorted it out.

Your replacement order Shop···· is in the warehouse queue now with the UK version of the S1 on it, nothing to pay, and I'll send you the tracking number as soon as it leaves Rotterdam. There is nothing you need to do in the meantime, and the faulty unit is yours to keep or recycle as you prefer.

If anything at all looks wrong when the new one arrives, just reply here and I'll pick it straight up.

It was genuinely a pleasure to get this one over the line for you. If you felt looked after in the end, a few words on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com . You're also very welcome in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf for setup help and new product news.

Kind regards,
Sarah
